Sunlight strikes Earth directly near the equator and at a slant near the poles
Latitude measures distance north or south of the equator from 0° to 90°
The equator at 0° latitude is halfway between the North and South Poles
The equator receives direct solar rays year-round, producing a hot climate with little sea
Equatorial regions have about 12 hours of daylight and darkness throughout the year

The Tropic of Capricorn at 23.5°S is the southernmost latitude where the sun can be direct
